---
title: "Ask for animated output only in GIF and WebP"
description: "Drop when the pinned release's transformer-cloudflare asks for animated output only in formats that support it."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.3. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

Every upload to a deployed Worker fails when the output is PNG, JPEG or
AVIF. resolveOutput() sets anim: true unless the format options turn it
off, whatever the output format, and deployed Cloudflare Images rejects
that with "IMAGES_TRANSFORM_ERROR 9401: Could not resize the image:
Animated output is only supported for GIF or WebP". The local binding
ignores anim, so vite dev and vite preview don't show the failure. The
transformer's README already says animation is kept only where the output
format supports it.

anim now defaults to true for GIF and WebP output and to false otherwise,
for uploads and for dynamic resizing. An explicit anim still wins. The
spec's stand-in for the Images binding rejects animated output in other
formats, as Cloudflare does.

- **Patch:** `transformer-cloudflare-animated-formats`, committed as `fix(transformer-cloudflare): ask for animated output only in GIF and WebP`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm --filter @payloadcms/transformer-cloudflare exec vitest run`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0017-fix-transformer-cloudflare-ask-for-animated-output-o.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0017-fix-transformer-cloudflare-ask-for-animated-output-o.patch)
